name: TidyBot++ mobile base, ARX5 variant
src: geometry: STEP; mass, payload, step, price: assumed

confidence.casters: cad (mesh); positions measured from the base mesh's corner plates

notes: Mesh: STEP from github.com/jimmyyhwu/tidybot2-resources, meshed with gmsh (catalog/fetch_assets.py). support_inset_m: the wheel contacts are taken to sit this far inside the outline. Mount 'top' takes a lift or an arm; 'front' takes a lidar or the ego camera. casters: the TidyBot++ powered caster module (STEP from the same repository, tessellated with OpenCascade), drawn at the four corner plates as [x, y, yaw in degrees]; they are for looks only: no mass, no collision, and the checks still use outline_m and support_inset_m.
